correctness.rationale: The irreducible simply-laced rank-at-most-four types are exactly A1,A2,A3,A4,D4. The generated roots and componentwise root order are exact. Both independent enumerators agree on every antichain and ideal; direct all-frequency sign sums equal integer Walsh–Hadamard transforms; Parseval checks pass, and the complete signed spectra in spectrum.csv reproduce the zeros and rank table. Fourier diagonalization proves each rank. The second exact transform and group-translation averaging prove each unrestricted sharp endpoint projection norm. The D4 triality permutation action is fully enumerated.

value.rationale: The antichain-versus-downset bijection is a central and natural Coxeter-Catalan construction; the full small-rank irreducible simply-laced comparison tests whether this correspondence respects ambient Boolean convolution recoverability. The first divergence at rank four is a structural threshold, not an arbitrary selected parameter. The exact counts yield a rigorous affine-equivalence obstruction, sharp endpoint recovery-stability norms and triality-compatible zero-orbit statistics for the first forked Dynkin type. No general theorem for all ranks is needed for this finite natural classification.
